segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who describes herself as 'practically allergic to everything,' report no allergic reaction, burning or negative response to this toner.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one specifically in the T-zone, report it helps keep oil in check and tightens the look of pores, though one of them later discovered the formula contains alcohol and started peeling on her nose after twice-daily use.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin that gets very oily in humid weather reports it is gentle, doesn't cause a reaction, and helps her makeup last longer, though she found it slightly drying when visiting a drier climate.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, including one specifically in the T-zone, report it helps control oil and tightens the appearance of pores; no reviewer reports it failing to manage oiliness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive or oily skin, report it does not dry out or leave a sticky film on the skin; against this, one reviewer discovered the formula contains alcohol despite its witch-hazel base and found her nose started peeling with twice-daily use, and another notes it can feel slightly drying in low-humidity climates.
concerns.blemishes: The one reviewer who addresses this specifically says she uses the toner for acne control at age 54; no other reviewer reports on its effect on breakouts specifically.

extraits.titre: In-depth review from a girl allergic to everything...
extraits.texte: I have never used a toner before and was looking for a gentle one for my very sensitive skin. I use this as part of my 5-Step Japanese Skincare Routine. I'll preface by saying I have combination skin that gets very oily in this humid Georgia weather, and I'm practically allergic to everything. Toners are the second step in the process after gentle washing your face, and is meant to clean up any leftover dirt or makeup without drying out your skin. You soak a cotton ball and wipe your face with it for a cool, crisp feeling. This witch hazel based toner is supposed to be much gentler than using an alcohol, which strips your skin of necessary oils and can cause acne. PROS: - gentle on skin and doesn't cause an allergic reaction - will remove stray makeup (though it won't replace a true makeup cleanser) - doesn't burn eyes or skin - doesn't strip all the oils - very cheap (especially in a double pack plus a $3 Amazon coupon) - a bottle will last a month or two with conscientious use - compatible with other products without causing a reaction - leaves a clean feeling - tightens up the pores, so great to use in the morning before makeup and at night - great for humid weather or oily skin to help makeup last longer CONS: - smells like nail polish remover (hold your breath while cleaning around the chin/mouth/nose) - is a little dry in certain climates, like when I visit Denver, CO (just immediately follow up with serum) - the only way to apply it is with a cotton ball or pad, which

Olay.... what more can you say? I love this product.... have used Olay toner for years... and now the stores no longer carry it.... so luckily Amazon has it available-thank goodness!! great product.... I have very oily skin and this helps keep that in check.... I use it in the morning and again at bedtime... my skin feels great!

Soothing witch hazel toner. Witch hazel is soothing and calms swelling; many uses medically. Appreciated it on my oily skin in T zone. Wondered why nose skin then started peeling after twice-daily use and discovered that this specific product contains alcohol, so switching to an alcohol-free product. Just a heads-up.

extraits.titre: Excellent toner containing witch hazel.Excellent toner containing witch hazel.
extraits.texte: Love this Olay product. I golf several times a week and walk a lot. After these activities my face feels salty. So I keep a bottle in my golf locker and a bottle at home so I have this toner handy. I simply put some on a cotton square and wipe down my face, neck, and the back of my neck……and I feel renewed. You don’t need to wash it off, and it dries fast without leaving a sticky film on your face. And it does not dry my face out…as it contains witch hazel. The value for the twin pack price is great, and the bottles last quite a while. It has a fresh scent and my skin does not react negatively to any of the ingredients. Since I have sensitive skin, I was concerned about this. But I had no issue at all. Very pleased and highly recommend.

extraits.titre: I love it, been using it for years!
